reference.source: Independent fresh standalone official UMD pages. Public original controls/props/data/refs, authored public pointer and keyboard gestures plus ordinary controlled-owner prop/value updates. No Native code, expected geometry, Source patches or result normalization.
reference.protocol: Unchanged official controls, actual raw OptionType/FieldNames owner. Raw and labeled single/multiple/tags values, raw optionLabelProp vs supplied label vs labelRender paths, actual rich React nodes, current filtered flatten selected style/title, public onSearch own undefined while owner closed. Every selection/open/search/active callback and every labelRender call retained. Common authored-rich-node identity receipts are declared before capture; full raw React node records and own descriptors separately retained. No expected coordinates/values, result correction or Native reads.

counterpart.onlyWhen: current dataset removed, original disabled:a.disabled true and raw a still selected
counterpart.keyPolicy: preventDefault and stopPropagation only cached removed-disabled Backspace with empty query
counterpart.titlePolicy: current actual info.label fallback, no old title retention
counterpart.metadataPolicy: labelRender receives original actual Source disabled/title undefined after removal; no metadata rewriting
counterpart.producerPolicy: all actual public owner tag/key calls kept separately, original labelRender and selection callbacks untouched
